title: [MCP] Register MCP server as a Copilot capability
summary: The MCP server is now registered as a Copilot capability on the Copilot & agent capabilities page, allowing administrators to activate or deactivate it. Deactivating the capability updates the Copilot Settings status, which the platform reads to control MCP availability.
key_points: MCP server registered as a Generally Available Copilot capability with standard Activate/Deactivate flow
Registered automatically on install, on upgrade, and via the Copilot capabilities page subscriber
Notifications appear on MCP Config pages when the capability is deactivated, with a link to the capabilities page
Existing MCP configurations remain unchanged when re-activating
Platform enforces MCP requests based on the Copilot Settings status for the MCP Server capability
